title: 4 Poems at Works and Days
pieces: What is Happening Now Cannot Happen Again

research.excerpt: What I want to say is something / about the translucence of clouds / being damn near pornographic. / The mood shifts with subtle rains until / all that’s left is background radiation.

notes: Works & Days Vol. 6 (Winter 2025), Beautiful Days Press. WP media upload 2025-12-21. Cover: Teo González “Extrudge”.
